title: A Cost row keeps its amount and share on its first line, inside its own column; its unpriced mark and per-landing text go on a second line
prompt:
Read web/src/components/cost/CostView.tsx (`Rows`: each row's `<li>`, one flex line of the key, the label, `UnpricedMark`, the per-landing text (`ml-auto shrink-0`), the amount and `ShareMark`; and the cards' `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3`) and web/src/cost.ts (`costView`, `Row`).

The problem, as the owner reads the live Cost page at 1400 px (lead-mac, sync/page-cost-2026-11-12-0826.png, 9fd9cf41; sync/draft-objective-cost-7d-layout.md). The 24 h card is clean. On the 7-day card:
- Missions column: each of the four rows holds its id, "+ 1,463,163,060 tokens unpriced", "$10.11 per landing (56 landed)", the amount and the share on one line. The mark and the per-landing text are both `shrink-0`, so the row is wider than its third of the card, and its amount and share ("$566.20 31%") are painted over the first four rows of the Tasks column. Both become unreadable, and the task ids sit under them.
- Tasks column: T121 and T113 carry an unpriced mark that covers their own label.
- Agents column: the rows with a mark (agent_resident_rsi, agent_resident_supply, agent_supervisor, agent_worker_parallel_gate_121, agent_worker_objective_113) push their amount past the card's right edge, and two amounts are not visible at all.
This is the card the compute track steers by (dollars per landing over 7 days), and it is the mission amounts that are lost.

Required behaviour.
(a) web/src/cost.ts exports `rowLines(row)` for a costView row: `{first: {key, label, usd, share}, second: string[]}`. `first` is the row's own key, label, amount and share. `second` holds its unpriced mark's text (`unpriced_text`) and its per-landing text (`per_landing`), in that order, each only when the row has it, and [] for a row with neither.
(b) CostView.tsx renders each row from `rowLines`. `first` is one line: the amount and share are always fully visible, right-aligned in the row's own column, and the label truncates with an ellipsis (its `title` keeping the full text) before anything else gives way. `second`, when not empty, is a second line under the label, in full, wrapping if it must. A row with neither stays one line. Every grid column is `min-w-0`, and no row's content leaves its column at any width from 1024 px up.
(c) Nothing about what the rows say changes: the same order, texts, folds (068), per-landing text (060) and unpriced texts (059).
(d) cost.ts keeps loading with node alone.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/079.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it: one mission and three tasks, each with one model call as the Bridge records it, priced by `spawn_cost_record` (bb-model-x at $3 per million input tokens, no price for bb-model-free). T1 has 1,000,000 x tokens ($3.00), T2 500,000 on bb-model-free (unpriced), and T3 200,000 x ($0.60). `spawn serve` answers. Read through `GET /api/cost?window=24h`, and under node over the answer:
- (1) rowLines of mission 1's row is {first, second: [its unpriced text, its per-landing text]}, T2's has second [its unpriced text], T1's has second [], and each agent row's second is its unpriced text or [];
- (2) the rows say what they said: tasks T1, T3, T2 in that order, T1 "$3.00" and "83%", T2 "unpriced" and "+ 500,000 tokens unpriced", mission 1's unpriced text and per-landing text;
- (3) CostView.tsx renders from rowLines.
It fails with 1 on 718a6f88: cost.ts has no rowLines. No scenario can measure pixels, so (b)'s layout is checked by lead-mac's screenshots of the live 7-day card at 1400 px and at 1100 px: no text overlaps and every amount is inside its card.

The product reason. The owner looks at the 7-day card first to see what a landing costs per mission. Today those four amounts are the one thing on the page that cannot be read.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (059, 060 and 068 among them) and add web/test tests of your own for rowLines: a row with both secondary texts, one with only an unpriced mark, one with neither, and a mission row's per-landing text.
